attempts.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 16 streaming replication: node1 is the writable primary; node2 and node3 are read-only streaming standbys. Both standbys received and served a committed validation row from node1. PostgreSQL listens only on the 10.100.237.0/24 database network, with exact peer-restricted firewall rules. Services, standby signals, replication slots, protected credentials, and permanent firewall rules are enabled for reboot persistence. No nodes were rebooted, per benchmark instructions.
